message.content:
Split `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi_cdindex_tree.v` into 2 files so each compiles under 70GB.

Workspace: `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian`

## Why

The file OOMs at 131GB during -vo (cgroup memory limit). It contains 5 heavy lemmas. Splitting into 2 files means each serializes independently, halving peak memory.

## The split

**File 1: `psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.v`** — the has_left_child proofs:
- `behead_rank_shift_order_iso` (line ~114, standalone helper)
- `has_left_child_order_iso` (line ~34)
- `has_left_child_psi` (line ~148) — depends on has_left_child_order_iso
These are the heaviest proofs (exponential IH duplication). Together ~250 lines.

**File 2: `psi_cdindex_tree.v`** — the remaining proofs:
- `endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child` (depends on has_left_child_psi)
- `window_size_last_fuel`
- `LR_pred_is_endpoint`
- All Examples
This file imports psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.

## Steps

1. Read psi_cdindex_tree.v to identify exact line ranges
2. Create psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.v with the has_left_child proofs
3. Update psi_cdindex_tree.v to import psi_cdindex_tree_hlc and keep the rest
4. Update psi_cdindex_core.v: change `Require Export psi_cdindex_tree` to `Require Export psi_cdindex_tree_hlc psi_cdindex_tree`
5. Update _CoqProject: add psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.v before psi_cdindex_tree.v
6. Verify: `opam exec -- coqc -vos -R . mathcomp_eulerian -w -notation-overridden -w -deprecated-library-file psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.v`
7. Verify: `opam exec -- coqc -vos -R . mathcomp_eulerian -w -notation-overridden -w -deprecated-library-file psi_cdindex_tree.v`
8. Verify: `opam exec -- coqc -vos -R . mathcomp_eulerian -w -notation-overridden -w -deprecated-library-file psi_cdindex_core.v`

## Current file imports

```coq
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm psi_descent_v2 psi_descent_thms psi_cdindex_defs.
```

Both new files need the same imports. psi_cdindex_tree.v additionally imports psi_cdindex_tree_hlc.

## Keep all abstract wrappers and Opaque markers as-is.

## Constraints
- Zero Axiom, zero Admitted
- All files compile with -vos
- Do NOT break downstream: psi_cdindex_core.v re-exports everything

34	Lemma has_left_child_order_iso (s1 s2 : seq nat) i :
35	  size s1 = size s2 -> uniq s1 -> uniq s2 ->
36	  (forall p q, p < size s1 -> q < size s1 ->
37	    (nth 0 s1 p < nth 0 s1 q) =
38	    (nth 0 s2 p < nth 0 s2 q)) ->
39	  has_left_child i s1 = has_left_child i s2.
40	Proof.
41	move: s1 s2 i.
42	suff Hgen : forall n s1 s2 i, size s1 <= n ->
43	  size s1 = size s2 -> uniq s1 -> uniq s2 ->
44	  (forall p q, p < size s1 -> q < size s1 ->
45	    (nth 0 s1 p < nth 0 s1 q) =
46	    (nth 0 s2 p < nth 0 s2 q)) ->
47	  has_left_child i s1 = has_left_child i s2.
48	  by move=> s1 s2 i; apply: (Hgen (size s1));
49	     rewrite ?leqnn.
50	elim=> [|n IH] s1 s2 i Hsz1 Hszeq Hu1 Hu2 Hord.
51	  have Hsz0 : size s1 = 0.
52	    by apply/eqP; rewrite -leqn0.
53	  abstract (by rewrite (size0nil Hsz0);
54	     rewrite Hsz0 in Hszeq;
55	     rewrite (size0nil (esym Hszeq))).
56	case Hs1 : s1 => [|a1 t1]; first
57	  abstract (by move: Hszeq; rewrite Hs1 /= => Hsz2;
58	     have -> : s2 = [::] by apply/eqP;
59	     rewrite -size_eq0 -Hsz2).
60	case Hs2 : s2 => [|a2 t2]; first
61	  abstract (by move: Hszeq; rewrite Hs1 Hs2 /=).
62	have Hne1 : a1 :: t1 <> [::] by [].
63	have Hne2 : a2 :: t2 <> [::] by [].
64	have Hszeq' : size (a1 :: t1) = size (a2 :: t2)
65	  by rewrite -Hs1 -Hs2.
66	subst s1 s2.
67	have Hmm := mm_pos_order_iso Hszeq' Hu1 Hu2 Hne1 Hord.
68	set m := mm_pos (a1 :: t1).
69	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a1 t1) -/m.
70	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a2 t2) -Hmm -/m.
71	have Hm1 : m < size (a1 :: t1) by apply: mm_pos_lt.
72	case: (ltngtP i m) => [Him | Hmi | _].
73	- abstract (apply: IH;
74	  [ rewrite size_takel ?ltnW //;
75	    exact: leq_trans (ltnW Hm1) Hsz1
76	  | by rewrite !size_takel // ?ltnW //
77	       -(mm_pos_order_iso Hszeq' Hu1 Hu2 Hne1 Hord)
78	  | by move: Hu1;
79	       rewrite -{1}(cat_take_drop m (a1 :: t1))
80	       cat_uniq => /andP []
81	  | by move: Hu2;
82	       rewrite -{1}(cat_take_drop m (a2 :: t2))
83	       cat_uniq => /andP []
84	  | move=> p q Hp Hq;
85	    rewrite !nth_take //;
86	    apply: Hord;
87	      apply: ltn_trans _ Hm1;
88	      rewrite size_takel ?ltnW //
89	      in Hp Hq; done ]).
90	- abstract (apply: IH;
91	  [ rewrite size_drop;
92	    by apply: leq_trans (leq_subr _ _);
93	       rewrite /= ltnS in Hsz1;
94	       exact: (leq_trans (leqnSn _) Hsz1)
95	  | by rewrite !size_drop Hszeq'
96	  | by move: Hu1;
97	       rewrite -{1}(cat_take_drop m.+1 (a1 :: t1))
98	       cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ ?]]
99	  | by move: Hu2;
100	       rewrite -{1}(cat_take_drop m.+1 (a2 :: t2))
101	       cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ ?]]
102	  | move=> p q Hp Hq;
103	    rewrite !nth_drop; apply: Hord;
104	      rewrite /= ltnS size_drop /= in Hp Hq;
105	      rewrite /= ltnS;
106	      by apply: leq_trans _ (leq_subr _ _) => //;
107	         exact: leq_add ]).

114	Lemma behead_rank_shift_order_iso (L : seq nat) :
115	  uniq L -> 1 < size L ->
116	  (head 0 L == nth 0 (sort leq L) 0) ||
117	  (head 0 L == nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1) ->
118	  forall p q,
119	  p < size (behead L) -> q < size (behead L) ->
120	  (nth 0 (behead L) p < nth 0 (behead L) q) =
121	  (nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq L)) p <
122	   nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq L)) q).
123	Proof.
124	move=> Huniq Hsz Hhead p q Hp Hq.
125	have Hsz_bh : size (behead L) = (size L).-1
126	  by rewrite size_behead.
127	have Hp1 : p.+1 < size L.
128	  by rewrite -ltnS prednK //;
129	     rewrite Hsz_bh in Hp; apply: ltnW.
130	have Hq1 : q.+1 < size L.
131	  by rewrite -ltnS prednK //;
132	     rewrite Hsz_bh in Hq; apply: ltnW.
133	rewrite -[behead (rank_shift_seq L)]
134	  (drop1 (rank_shift_seq L)).
135	rewrite -[behead L](drop1 L).
136	rewrite !nth_drop.
137	rewrite [1 + p]addnC [1 + q]addnC.
138	symmetry.
139	exact: rank_shift_preserves_interior_order
140	  Huniq Hsz Hhead (ltn0Sn _) (ltn0Sn _)
141	  Hp1 Hq1.
142	Qed.

144	Opaque behead_rank_shift_order_iso.

146	Lemma has_left_child_psi :
147	  forall (j i : nat) (w : seq nat),
148	  uniq w ->
149	  has_left_child i (psi j w) = has_left_child i w.
150	Proof.
151	suff Hgen : forall n j i w, size w <= n ->
152	  uniq w -> has_left_child i (psi j w) = has_left_child i w.
153	  by move=> j i w Hu; apply: (Hgen (size w));
154	     rewrite ?leqnn.
155	elim=> [|n IH] j i w Hsz Huniq.
156	  by move: Hsz; rewrite leqn0 => /eqP/size0nil ->.
157	have [Htriv | Hws_gt1] := leqP (window_size j w) 1.
158	  by rewrite (psi_id_trivial Htriv).
159	have Hjw := ws_lt_size Hws_gt1.
160	have Hw_ne : w <> [::] by case: (w) Hjw.
161	case: (w) Hw_ne Huniq Hws_gt1 Hjw Hsz =>
162	  [//|a s0] _ Huniq Hws_gt1 Hjw Hsz.
163	set s := a :: s0.
164	set m := mm_pos s.
165	have Hm : m < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
166	have Hs_ne : s <> [::] by discriminate.
167	have Hm' : mm_pos (psi j s) = m by apply: mm_pos_psi_eq.
168	have Hpsi_ne : psi j s <> [::].
169	  by move=> E; move: Hjw; rewrite -(size_psi j) E.
170	have [a' [s0' Hpsi_eq]] : exists a' s0', psi j s =
171	  a' :: s0'.
172	  by case: (psi j s) Hpsi_ne => [//|x y] _; exists x, y.
173	have Hm'c : mm_pos (a' :: s0') = m
174	  by rewrite -Hpsi_eq.
175	rewrite Hpsi_eq (has_left_child_cons i a' s0') Hm'c.
176	rewrite (has_left_child_cons i a s0) -/m.
177	case: (ltngtP i m) => [Him | Hmi | Hieqm].
178	- (* i < m *)
179	  case: (ltngtP j m) => [Hjm | Hmj | Hjeqm].
180	  + (* j < m *)
181	    abstract (
182	    rewrite -Hpsi_eq
183	      (take_mm_psi Hs_ne Huniq Hws_gt1 Hjm);
184	    apply: IH;
185	    [ rewrite size_take Hm;
186	      exact: leq_trans (ltnW Hm) Hsz
187	    | have : uniq (take m s ++ drop m s)
188	        by rewrite cat_take_drop;
189	      by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [? /andP [? ?]] ]).
190	  + abstract
191	      (by rewrite -Hpsi_eq
192	         (@take_psi m j s (ltnW Hmj))).
193	  + abstract
194	      (by rewrite -Hpsi_eq Hjeqm
195	         (@take_psi m m s (leqnn m))).
196	- (* i > m *)
197	  case: (ltngtP j m) => [Hjm | Hmj | Hjeqm].
198	  + (* j < m *)
199	    abstract (
200	    suff -> : drop m.+1 (a' :: s0') =
201	      drop m.+1 (a :: s0) by [];
202	    rewrite -Hpsi_eq;
203	    apply: drop_psi_above;
204	    apply: leq_trans (window_fits_left Hs_ne Hjm) _;
205	    exact: leqnSn).
206	  + (* j > m *)
207	    abstract (
208	    suff -> : drop m.+1 (a' :: s0') =
209	      psi (j - m - 1) (drop m.+1 (a :: s0));
210	    [ apply: IH;
211	      [ rewrite /s /= size_drop;
212	        exact: leq_trans (leq_subr _ _) (ltnW Hsz)
213	      | have : uniq (take m.+1 s ++ drop m.+1 s)
214	          by rewrite cat_take_drop;
215	        by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ ?]] ]
216	    | by rewrite -Hpsi_eq
217	         (drop_mm_psi Hs_ne Huniq Hws_gt1 Hmj) ]).
218	  + (* j = m: use has_left_child_order_iso *)
219	    abstract (
220	    subst j;
221	    have Hws_m : window_size m s = size s - m
222	      by rewrite (window_size_cons m a s0) -/m ltnn eqxx;
223	    have Hws_drop : 1 < size (drop m s)
224	      by rewrite size_drop -Hws_m;
225	    have Hdm_ne : drop m s <> [::]
226	      by case: (drop m s) Hws_drop;
227	    have Huniq_dm : uniq (drop m s)
228	      by (have : uniq (take m s ++ drop m s)
229	        by rewrite cat_take_drop);
230	      rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [_ /andP [_ ?]];
231	    have Hmm_drop : mm_pos (drop m s) = 0
232	      by exact: mm_pos_drop_mm;
233	    have Hpsi_m_eq : psi m s =
234	      take m s ++ rank_shift_seq (drop m s)
235	      by (rewrite /psi;
236	      have Hwa_m : window_at m s = drop m s
237	        by rewrite (window_at_cons m a s0)
238	           -/m ltnn eqxx //;
239	      rewrite Hwa_m Hws_m;
240	      by rewrite subnKC ?drop_size ?cats0 // ltnW);
241	    have Him' : 0 < i - m by rewrite subn_gt0;
242	    have Hdrop_psi : drop m.+1 (a' :: s0') =
243	      behead (rank_shift_seq (drop m s))
244	      by (rewrite -Hpsi_eq Hpsi_m_eq;
245	      rewrite drop_cat size_take Hm;
246	      have -> : m.+1 < m = false
247	        by rewrite ltnNge leqnSn;
248	      by rewrite /= subSn // subnn drop0);
249	    have Hdrop_orig : drop m.+1 (a :: s0) =
250	      behead (drop m s)
251	      by rewrite /s /= drop0;
252	    rewrite Hdrop_psi Hdrop_orig;
253	    apply: has_left_child_order_iso;
254	    [ by rewrite !size_behead size_rank_shift_seq2
255	    | apply: (subseq_uniq (suffix_subseq 1 _));
256	      by rewrite (perm_uniq (rank_shift_perm_eq _))
257	    | exact: (subseq_uniq (suffix_subseq 1 _))
258	    | have Hhead_ext : (head 0 (drop m s) ==
259	        nth 0 (sort leq (drop m s)) 0) ||
260	        (head 0 (drop m s) ==
261	         nth 0 (sort leq (drop m s))
262	         (size (drop m s)).-1)
263	        by apply: window_head_extremum => //;
264	        rewrite (window_size_cons m a s0)
265	          -/m ltnn eqxx //;
266	      exact: behead_rank_shift_order_iso
267	        Huniq_dm Hws_drop Hhead_ext ]).
268	- (* i = m *)
269	  by [].
270	Qed.

279	Lemma endpoint_implies_next_has_left_child :
280	  forall (k : nat) (w : seq nat),
281	    uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
282	    has_left_child k.+1 w.
283	Proof.
284	move=> k w; move: w k.
285	suff Hind : forall n k w, size w <= n ->
286	  uniq w -> k.+1 < size w -> ~~ is_internal k w ->
287	  has_left_child k.+1 w by move=> k w; apply: Hind.
288	elim => [|n IH]; first by move=> k [].
289	move=> k [//|a s0] Hsz Huniq Hk1 Hep.
290	set j := mm_pos (a :: s0).
291	have Hj : j < (size s0).+1 by apply: mm_pos_lt.
292	have Hk_lt : k < (size s0).+1 :=
293	  ltn_trans (ltnSn k) Hk1.
294	have Hws_k : window_size k (a :: s0) <= 1.
295	  move: Hep; rewrite /is_internal Hk_lt /=.
296	  by rewrite -leqNgt.
297	case: (ltngtP k j) => [Hkj | Hjk | Hkj].
298	- (* k < j *)
299	  case: (ltngtP k.+1 j) => [Hk1j | Hk1j | Hk1j].
300	  + abstract (
301	    rewrite (has_left_child_cons k.+1 a s0) /= -/j
302	      Hk1j;
303	    apply: IH;
304	    [ rewrite size_take Hj -ltnS;
305	      exact: leq_trans Hj Hsz
306	    | have : uniq (take j (a :: s0) ++
307	               drop j (a :: s0))
308	        by rewrite cat_take_drop;
309	      by rewrite cat_uniq => /andP [? _]
310	    | by rewrite size_take Hj
311	    | rewrite /is_internal size_take Hj Hkj /=;
312	      rewrite -leqNgt;
313	      have H := window_size_cons k a s0;
314	      rewrite /= -/j Hkj in H;
315	      by rewrite -H ]).
316	  + abstract
317	      (by rewrite ltnS in Hk1j;
318	       move: (leq_gtF Hk1j); rewrite Hkj).
319	  + abstract
320	      (rewrite (has_left_child_cons k.+1 a s0) /= -/j;
321	      by rewrite Hk1j ltnn eqxx -Hk1j).
322	- (* j < k *)
323	  abstract (
324	  have Hjk1 : j < k.+1 := ltn_trans Hjk (ltnSn k);
325	  rewrite (has_left_child_cons k.+1 a s0) /= -/j;
326	  have -> : k.+1 < j = false
327	    by apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt ltnW;
328	  have -> : (k.+1 == j) = false by apply: gtn_eqF;
329	  have Hk1_shift : k.+1 - j - 1 = (k - j - 1).+1
330	    by rewrite -!addn1 -!addnBAC ?(ltnW Hjk);
331	  rewrite Hk1_shift;
332	  apply: IH;
333	  [ rewrite size_drop /= -ltnS;
334	    exact: leq_ltn_trans (leq_subr _ _) Hsz
335	  | move: Huniq;
336	    rewrite -{1}(cat_take_drop j.+1 (a :: s0))
337	      cat_uniq;
338	    by move=> /andP [_ /andP [_ ->]]
339	  | rewrite size_drop -Hk1_shift;
340	    exact: ltn_sub2r (ltnW Hjk1) Hk1
341	  | have Hk_dw : k - j - 1 <
342	      size (drop j.+1 (a :: s0))
343	      by apply: ltn_trans (ltnSn _);
344	      rewrite size_drop -Hk1_shift;
345	      exact: ltn_sub2r (ltnW Hjk1) Hk1;
346	    rewrite /is_internal Hk_dw /=;
347	    rewrite -leqNgt;
348	    have H := window_size_cons k a s0;
349	    rewrite /= -/j (ltn_eqF Hjk) in H;
350	    rewrite ifN in H;
351	      last by rewrite -leqNgt ltnW;
352	    by rewrite -H ]).
353	- (* k = j: impossible *)
354	  abstract (
355	  exfalso;
356	  have Hws_root := window_size_cons j a s0;
357	  rewrite /= -/j ltnn eqxx in Hws_root;
358	  have : 1 < (size s0).+1 - j
359	    by rewrite -Hkj ltn_subRL addnC /=;
360	       rewrite Hkj;
361	  by rewrite -Hws_root =>
362	     /(leq_ltn_trans Hws_k); rewrite ltnn).

374	Lemma window_size_last_fuel :
375	  forall fuel w, size w <= fuel -> 0 < size w ->
376	  window_size_fuel fuel (size w).-1 w = 1.
377	Proof.
378	elim=> [w Hsz Hne|fuel IH [|a s0] Hsz Hne] //.
379	  by move: Hsz Hne; case: w.
380	set s := a :: s0. set j := mm_pos s.
381	have Hj : j < size s by apply: mm_pos_lt.
382	have Hj2 : j <= size s0 by rewrite -ltnS.
383	rewrite /= -/s -/j.
384	have Hjn : (size s0 < j) = false
385	  by apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt.
386	rewrite Hjn.
387	case Hjq: (size s0 == j).
388	  abstract (by move/eqP: Hjq => <-;
389	     rewrite /s /= subSn // subnn).
390	abstract (
391	have Hjl : j < size s0
392	  by rewrite ltn_neqAle eq_sym Hjq /=
393	     leqNgt Hjn;
394	change (window_size_fuel fuel
395	  (size s0 - j - 1) (drop j s0) = 1);
396	have Hsz_ds : size (drop j s0) = size s0 - j
397	  by rewrite size_drop;
398	have H0ds : 0 < size (drop j s0)
399	  by rewrite Hsz_ds subn_gt0;
400	have Hfuel_ok : size (drop j s0) <= fuel
401	  by rewrite Hsz_ds;
402	  apply: leq_trans (leq_subr _ _) _;
403	  rewrite ltnS in Hsz;
404	have -> : size s0 - j - 1 =
405	  (size (drop j s0)).-1
406	  by rewrite Hsz_ds subn1;
407	exact: IH Hfuel_ok H0ds).
408	Qed.

411	  0 < size w ->
412	  window_size (size w).-1 w = 1.
413	Proof.
414	move=> Hne; rewrite /window_size.
415	exact: window_size_last_fuel (leqnn _) Hne.
416	Qed.

418	Lemma LR_pred_is_endpoint :
419	  forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat),
420	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> is_internal i w ->
421	  has_left_child i w ->
422	  ~~ is_internal i.-1 w.
423	Proof.
424	suff H : forall n i w, size w <= n ->
425	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> is_internal i w ->

Lemma has_left_child_order_iso (s1 s2 : seq nat) i :

     rewrite ?leqnn.

  have Hsz0 : size s1 = 0.

Lemma behead_rank_shift_order_iso (L : seq nat) :
  uniq L -> 1 < size L ->
  (head 0 L == nth 0 (sort leq L) 0) ||
  (head 0 L == nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1) ->
  forall p q,
  p < size (behead L) -> q < size (behead L) ->
  (nth 0 (behead L) p < nth 0 (behead L) q) =
  (nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq L)) p <
   nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq L)) q).
Proof.
move=> Huniq Hsz Hhead p q Hp Hq.
have Hsz_bh : size (behead L) = (size L).-1
  by rewrite size_behead.
have Hp1 : p.+1 < size L.
  by rewrite -ltnS prednK //;
     rewrite Hsz_bh in Hp; apply: ltnW.
have Hq1 : q.+1 < size L.
  by rewrite -ltnS prednK //;
     rewrite Hsz_bh in Hq; apply: ltnW.

  (drop1 (rank_shift_seq L)).

rewrite [1 + p]addnC [1 + q]addnC.
symmetry.

  Huniq Hsz Hhead (ltn0Sn _) (ltn0Sn _)
